question: Is RotoWire information arriving correctly and, if so, exactly where is the model failing to USE it?

SOURCE_EVENT.evidence: 40 live absences of regulars (trailing-5 >= 24 min, played previous game): 21 never listed on the acquired RotoWire pages (injury report + injury news), 3 postgame-only DNP notes; RotoWire CBB injury news is DATE_ONLY (no provider time)
SOURCE_EVENT.class: 1 SOURCE (silent / postgame-only) for 24 of 40 = INFORMATION-LIMITED with the acquired pages

INGEST.evidence: acquisition only at 08:30/10:00/13:00/16:00/18:00 ET; 127 of 266 news items (48%) first collected the day after their displayed date (106 at the 08:00-08:30 ET run); 7 of 10 late live cases had a same-day OUT posted before tip but collected after the prediction cutoff (two 20:00 tips collected next morning)
INGEST.fix: cutoff-aligned acquisitions (Phase A, no writer lock) so every game's T-1h cutoff has an acquisition within the 20-min freshness bound; the designed cadence ROTOWIRE_POLL_MINUTES (GAME_DAY 10 / CRITICAL_PRE_TIP 5) is PROPOSED_NOT_APPROVED
INGEST.blocker: HUMAN: approve the automated request cadence against the RotoWire subscriber web pages (terms of the subscription)

PLAYER_ID.evidence: 748 / 832 events RESOLVED (89.9%); 84 UNMATCHED fail their games closed; 1 of 40 live absences an unmatched-identity candidate

STATUS.evidence: Out/Out For Season/ruled out/won't play -> OUT / LONG_TERM_OUT; GTD -> GTD; 'expected to play' -> QUESTIONABLE (conservative)

LINEUP_STATE.evidence: no projected / confirmed lineup page is acquired (only injury report + injury news)

PLAYER_STATE_MIXTURE.evidence: OUT -> player removed (CONFIRMED_UNAVAILABLE); GTD / uncertain -> row gated (AVAILABILITY_UNCERTAIN_ROTATION); no state mixture (P(play) never conditioned on status)
PLAYER_STATE_MIXTURE.class: 6 PLAYER STATE: binary remove / gate only

TEAMMATE_REDISTRIBUTION.evidence: prod/inputs.apply_availability removes the player and flags UNSUPPORTED_ROTATION_SHOCK; JM1 has no team-minutes reconciliation. Box truth: one regular out -> teammates minutes x1.12, PTS x1.17 (2024-25: see r6), {"2025": {"m_ratio": 1.1179, "pts_ratio": 1.1684, "reb_ratio": 1.1426, "ast_ratio": 1.1962}, "2026": {"m_ratio": 1.1223, "pts_ratio": 1.1686, "reb_ratio": 1.1414, "ast_ratio": 1.1744}}

PLAYER_PMFS.evidence: the official T-1h shadow tick (prod.shadow_tick -> run.daily) is called WITHOUT rotowire_root / availability: run_summary.availability = null in 27 of 31 runs on 2026-11-25 (only the 4 availability-refresh forecasts apply RotoWire); exports use the official tick prediction when it exists (exports.distribution_records), so the published / graded PMF never conditions on RotoWire
PLAYER_PMFS.class: 8 PMFs FAILED TO REGENERATE WITH THE INFORMATION at the official checkpoint
PLAYER_PMFS.fix: pass the RotoWire store to the tick's run.daily once ingestion is cutoff-aligned (otherwise the 20-min freshness bound fails every game closed)

GAME_PMF.evidence: GameJointPMF uses team ratings only; no player availability input

BOARD.evidence: UNSUPPORTED_ROTATION_SHOCK / AVAILABILITY_UNCERTAIN_ROTATION games are never wager-eligible; still shadow-published
